items.title: Rossano Sportiello interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 2, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And on one you were playing “A Well-Tempered Clavier.” ... Yeah, in Italian we say, “Un Clavicembalo ben temperato.” The Well-Tempered Clavier.

ctx.x: I won’t try to say that because it won’t sound as good. Yesterday I was listening to two different recordings that you did. And on one you were playing “A Well-Tempered Clavier.” How do you say that?
Yeah, in Italian we say, “Un Clavicembalo ben temperato.” The Well-Tempered Clavier. Yeah. I recorded a prelude in one of my CDs, just as a piano solo.
That’s what I was listening to. And then I put on “The St. Louis Blues” that you did with Nicki and Eddie.
